0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Vyurvarjur has just filled his vials with wardingwater.

24.original: Search the designated areas, weaken any elder flints that appear, and sprinkle them with wardingwater.

48.original: You there! By my reckoning, you look to be precisely the sort of seasoned warrior we need right now.

49.original: Not far from these ruins, there are craters where the heat of Valigarmanda's scorching devastation yet lingers, attracting swarms of elder flints.

50.original: If left unchecked, these rock-like creatures will feed on the flames there until they explode. A gathering of flints could incite a chain reaction with greater potential for harm.

51.original: Normally we stamp them out on sight, but they have begun to multiply faster than we can rout them, and we are regrettably shorthanded. Thus did I devise a means to impede their proliferation.

52.original: Would you weaken the elder flints swarming the craters and sprinkle this wardingwater upon them? If it is not too much to ask, of course.

53.original: We need but weaken the elder flints and sprinkle them with wardingwater. Would you take up that task on our behalf?

58.original: You see no sign of any rock-like monsters.

59.original: Forgive me─I thought I would observe your progress from a safe distance. But I see now that my plan was a success!

60.original: You see, our wardingwater is collected from the sacred depths of Karvarhur the First. It has the power to greatly diminish fire energy stored within an elder flint.

61.original: Subsequently, those imbued with water don't <hex:021A020203>explode<hex:021A020103> so much as fizzle out. In this way, only the comparatively less dangerous creatures will be allowed to multiply safely.

62.original: So long as we continue our regular exterminations, we need no longer live in fear of large-scale explosions. Now, please accept a small payment for your assistance!
